summary: Avoid checkpoint identity walks while waiting for a participant's first seal

rules.detail: First seals are still published immediately. Refreshing an existing seal is deferred while any participant has no seal; when all seals exist, current identities are computed and any changed seal is published before verification.

compatibility.detail: Seal terms, verification and certificate formats are unchanged; mixed-version peers remain compatible.

recovery.detail: An older build resumes refreshing seals during the wait without changing checkpoint correctness.
